item.description:
• A dream interrupted by a database hiccup now resumes where it left off instead of failing.
  • Kit stays responsive while it imports and generates memories.
  • Claude Desktop and Claude Code reconnect cleanly after a Kit rename.
  • Your model choice now applies to everything Kit does, not just chat.
  • Beta monitoring now reports which runtime Kit runs on and whether its services are healthy; the terms page spells out exactly what is sent.
